Three components in the patient chart app import `WarningIcon` from `@openmrs/esm-framework`. A change to its behaviour could affect all three. Each renders it at `size={16}` in an order basket item tile. I searched this checkout only (`.ts` and `.tsx` files) and didn't open the files, so the ranges below cover each import line through its render line, not the whole component.

1. The drug order basket tile imports it at line 5 and renders it at line 91 (`esm-patient-medications-app`, `order-basket-item-tile.component.tsx`).
2. The lab order basket tile imports it at line 5 and renders it at line 46 (`esm-patient-tests-app`, `lab-order-basket-item-tile.component.tsx`).
3. The general order basket tile imports it at line 5 and renders it at line 38 (`esm-patient-orders-app`, `order-basket-item-tile.component.tsx`).
